messages:
Elena (Finance): FYI vendor sent renewal quote for ModelOps Suite. flagged the annual escalation at 8% and a one-year auto-renew. attaching excerpt.
Vendor Rep (LumenCorp): Thanks Elena — we've proposed standard escalator at 8% in year 2+. Open to discussion on caps.
Sam (Sourcing): 8% feels high. what flexibility for multi-year committed pricing?
Vendor Rep (LumenCorp): For 2-year commit we can do 6% year-over-year, 3-year commit 5%.
Joyce (AcctOps): Also need sample invoice format and billing cadence. We prefer monthly in arrears with line for usage and line for support fee.
Vendor Rep (LumenCorp): Invoice sample here: https://lumen.example/invoice-sample.pdf
Elena (Finance): Also need termination rights if usage drops — request: 'Customer may terminate without penalty if spend drops >50% vs prior quarter, after 30-day cure.'
Mike (Legal): Draft counterproposal below. Please review:
```
Price Escalation Cap: Notwithstanding the foregoing, annual price increases shall not exceed 5% per contract year.
Termination for Material Decline: Customer may terminate for convenience without termination fee if Customer's monthly billed usage declines by more than 50% for any rolling 90-day period; termination effective 30 days after written notice.
```
Sam (Sourcing): That looks good. vendor, can you accept cap at 5% with 3-year commit at 5%/yr and no termination penalty per above?
Vendor Rep (LumenCorp): Need to check with pricing ops. 5% cap may be tight but we can do 5% on 3-year commit. Termination without fee — need to confirm, normally we require pro-rated minimums.
Elena (Finance): If they require minimums, ask for crediting unused committed capacity as invoices credit rather than cash penalties.
Joyce (AcctOps): Also make sure taxes and pass-throughs are explicit on the invoice. and support fees separated. We don't want surprise bundling.
Mike (Legal): Add clause: 'Unused committed capacity may be carried forward or credited at list rate to future invoices for 12 months.'
procurement-bot: @Sam created PR-1347 (vendor contract redline) and assigned to @Mike, @Elena for review.
Sam (Sourcing): I'll wait on vendor confirmation then will route to procurement approval board. target: finalize before 2026-04-15.
Vendor Rep (LumenCorp): Confirmed we can accept 5% with 3-year commit and credit option for unused capacity. I'll send redline by EOD.
Elena (Finance): Great — when they send redline, need final runbook for billing reconciliation: fields we require on invoice: invoice number, period start/end, usage line items (model tokens, inference hours), committed discount line, tax lines, PO ref.
Joyce (AcctOps): pls include sample CSV export of usage mapping to invoice lines — helps automate reconciliation.
Vendor Rep (LumenCorp): Will include CSV export sample and updated contract redline. thanks.
Mike (Legal): thx all, I'll prepare final redline and flag any non-standard IP/ data retention items separately.
Elena (Finance): thanks team. cc @CFO for visibility. :thumbsup:
